verdict.rationale: Mintlify's docs.json is documented as the central config that 'controls your site's global settings, including visual branding', and custom domains let the site live under the brand's own URL. That supports basic brand alignment, but the pack gives no specifics on how deep customization goes. Missing for 10: documented theme selection, font configuration, layout control, custom CSS/JS injection, support for user-built custom components, and independent or hands-on corroboration of branding flexibility.
